# Game start (wm_party_on_actions.txt): each party's house knows its party (var:wm_house_party on the house)
# and the party leader heads the house.
wm_party_houses_init_effect = {
	house:wm_house_party_labour ?= {
		set_variable = { name = wm_house_party value = title:k_party_labour }
	}
	title:k_party_labour.holder ?= {
		save_scope_as = wm_house_leader
		if = {
			limit = {
				house ?= house:wm_house_party_labour
				is_house_head = no
			}
			house = { set_house_head = scope:wm_house_leader }
		}
	}

# Character: put them in the house of their party (var:wm_party); without a party, a member of a party's house
# moves to the Independent house. Founded parties: the house of the party's leader.
wm_party_sync_house_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = var:wm_party }
		if = {
			limit = { var:wm_party = title:k_party_labour }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { house ?= house:wm_house_party_labour } }
				set_house = house:wm_house_party_labour
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:wm_party = title:k_party_conservative }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { house ?= house:wm_house_party_conservative } }
				set_house = house:wm_house_party_conservative
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:wm_party = title:k_party_lib_dem }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { house ?= house:wm_house_party_lib_dem } }
				set_house = house:wm_house_party_lib_dem
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:wm_party = title:k_party_snp }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { house ?= house:wm_house_party_snp } }
				set_house = house:wm_house_party_snp
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:wm_party = title:k_party_sinn_fein }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { house ?= house:wm_house_party_sinn_fein } }
				set_house = house:wm_house_party_sinn_fein
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:wm_party = title:k_party_reform }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { house ?= house:wm_house_party_reform } }
				set_house = house:wm_house_party_reform
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:wm_party = title:k_party_dup }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { house ?= house:wm_house_party_dup } }
				set_house = house:wm_house_party_dup
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:wm_party = title:k_party_green }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { house ?= house:wm_house_party_green } }
				set_house = house:wm_house_party_green
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:wm_party = title:k_party_plaid }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { house ?= house:wm_house_party_plaid } }
				set_house = house:wm_house_party_plaid
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:wm_party = title:k_party_sdlp }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { house ?= house:wm_house_party_sdlp } }
				set_house = house:wm_house_party_sdlp
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:wm_party = title:k_party_alliance }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { house ?= house:wm_house_party_alliance } }
				set_house = house:wm_house_party_alliance
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:wm_party = title:k_party_uup }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { house ?= house:wm_house_party_uup } }
				set_house = house:wm_house_party_uup
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:wm_party = title:k_party_tuv }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { house ?= house:wm_house_party_tuv } }
				set_house = house:wm_house_party_tuv
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				exists = var:wm_party.holder.house
				var:wm_party.holder.house.var:wm_house_party ?= var:wm_party
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { house ?= var:wm_party.holder.house } }
				set_house = var:wm_party.holder.house
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			house ?= { has_variable = wm_house_party }
		}
		set_house = house:wm_house_independent
	}
	# Their ideology fits their party (wm_ideo_effects.txt): crossing the floor or being elected moves it
	wm_ideo_fit_party_effect = yes
}

# Cross the Floor (wm_party_decisions.txt): the party picked in the decision's list (scope:wm_join_<party>).
wm_party_join_chosen_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_labour ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_labour }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_conservative ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_conservative }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_lib_dem ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_lib_dem }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_snp ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_snp }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_sinn_fein ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_sinn_fein }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_reform ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_reform }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_dup ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_dup }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_green ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_green }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_plaid ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_plaid }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_sdlp ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_sdlp }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_alliance ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_alliance }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_uup ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_uup }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_tuv ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_tuv }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_new_1 ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_new_1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_new_2 ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_new_2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_new_3 ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_new_3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_new_4 ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_new_4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_new_5 ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_new_5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_new_6 ?= yes }
		wm_party_join_effect = { PARTY = title:k_party_new_6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:wm_join_independent ?= yes }
		wm_party_leave_effect = yes
	}
}

# Found a Party: the first free slot (k_party_new_<n> with no holder).
wm_party_found_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = title:k_party_new_1.holder } }
		wm_party_found_in_slot_effect = { SLOT = new_1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = title:k_party_new_2.holder } }
		wm_party_found_in_slot_effect = { SLOT = new_2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = title:k_party_new_3.holder } }
		wm_party_found_in_slot_effect = { SLOT = new_3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = title:k_party_new_4.holder } }
		wm_party_found_in_slot_effect = { SLOT = new_4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = title:k_party_new_5.holder } }
		wm_party_found_in_slot_effect = { SLOT = new_5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = title:k_party_new_6.holder } }
		wm_party_found_in_slot_effect = { SLOT = new_6 }
	}
}
